records.description: 64 photographic prints. | Photographs show U.S. Public Health Service survey for malaria control as a member of the League of Nations malaria investigation committee to India in 1929-1930, and the PHS investigation commission to the China-Burma Highway in 1939-1940. Chefang Valley and Burma Road. Testing, sampling, dusting, spraying breeding places of malaria mosquitoes. Educational control work. Drainage ditches in irrigated rice fields. Terraced hillside farm. Children in India.
